arxiv-1805-12228.title: Classification of the Orthogonal Separable Webs for the Hamilton–Jacobi and Klein–Gordon Equations on 3-Dimensional Minkowski Space
arxiv-1805-12228.creator: Carlos VALERO a and Raymond G. MCLENAGHAN b
arxiv-1805-12228.description: Abstract We review a new theory of orthogonal separation of variables on pseudo-Riemannian spaces of constant zero curvature via concircular tensors and warped products. We then apply this theory to three-dimensional Minkowski space, obtaining an invariant classification of the forty-five orthogonal separable webs modulo the action of the isometry group.

arxiv-2102-03104.title: Harmonic generation in the interaction of laser with a magnetized overdense plasma
arxiv-2102-03104.creator: Srimanta Maity, Devshree Mandal, Ayushi Vashistha, Laxman Prasad Goswami, Amita Das
arxiv-2102-03104.description: Abstract The mechanism of harmonic generation in both O and X-mode configurations for a magnetized plasma has been explored here in detail with the help of Particle-In-Cell (PIC) simulations. A detailed characterization of both the reflected and transmitted electromagnetic radiation propagating in the bulk of the plasma has been carried out for this purpose.

Given a domain \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} , we prove that any stable solution to the equation -\Delta u=f(u) in \Omega satisfies • a BMO interior regularity when n=10 , • an Morrey M^{p_{n},4+2/(p_{n}-2)} interior regularity when n\geq 11 , where p_{n}=\frac{2(n-2\sqrt{n-1}-2)}{n-2\sqrt{n-1}-4}. This result is optimal as hinted by e.g.

arxiv-2107-09796.title: Microscopic dynamics of escaping groups through an exit and a corridor
arxiv-2107-09796.creator: E.A. Rozan, G.A. Frank, F.E. Cornes, I.M. Sticco, C.O. Dorso
arxiv-2107-09796.description: Abstract This research explores the dynamics of emergency evacuations in the presence of social groups. The investigation was carried out in the context of the basic Social Force Model (SFM). We included attractive feelings between people belonging to the same social group, as proposed in Ref. FrankDorso .

arxiv-2108-06691.title: Closed-Form Hybrid Beamforming Solution for Spectral Efficiency Upper Bound Maximization in mmWave MIMO-OFDM Systems Thanks: This work has been supported in part by Academy of Finland under 6Genesis Flagship (grant 318927) and EERA Project (grant 332362).
arxiv-2108-06691.creator: Mengyuan Ma, Nhan Thanh Nguyen and Markku Juntti
arxiv-2108-06691.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mengyuan Ma, Nhan Thanh Nguyen and Markku Juntti. Hybrid beamforming is considered a key enabler to realize millimeter wave (mmWave) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communications due to its capability of considerably reducing the number of costly and power-hungry radio frequency chains in the transceiver. However, in mmWave MIMO orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems, hybrid beamforming design is challenging because the analog precoder and combiner are required to be shared across the whole employed bandwidth.

arxiv-2112-15351.title: Learning to Predict 3D Lane Shape and Camera Pose from a Single Image via Geometry Constraints
arxiv-2112-15351.creator: Ruijin Liu, Dapeng Chen, Tie Liu, Zhiliang Xiong, Zejian Yuan
arxiv-2112-15351.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ruijin Liu, Dapeng Chen, Tie Liu, Zhiliang Xiong, Zejian Yuan. Detecting 3D lanes from the camera is a rising problem for autonomous vehicles. In this task, the correct camera pose is the key to generating accurate lanes, which can transform an image from perspective-view to the top-view. With this transformation, we can get rid of the perspective effects so that 3D lanes would look similar and can accurately be fitted by low-order polynomials.

arxiv-2303-11636.title: A Foundation of σ \sigma -superadditive Measures – a note on advancing Kalina measures –
arxiv-2303-11636.creator: Kiri Sakahara, Takashi Sato
arxiv-2303-11636.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kiri Sakahara, Takashi Sato. The present paper attempts to modify the way of constructing a measure in the Alternative Set Theory setting originally devised by Martin Kalina. Introducing a system of cuts of rational numbers extended with some special ones, it is proved that the measure which is nondecreasing, nonnegative and “depending on the way of measurement” as same as Kalina’s, but exhibits σ \sigma -superadditivity is obtained.

arxiv-2306-08077.title: Phase synchronization in a sparse network of randomly connected neurons under the effect of Poissonian spike inputs
arxiv-2306-08077.creator: Bruno R. R. Boaretto, Paulo R. Protachevicz, Matheus Hansen, Jonas Oliveira, Alexandre C. Andreani, Elbert E. N. Macau
arxiv-2306-08077.description: Abstract This article investigates the emergence of phase synchronization in a network of randomly connected neurons by chemical synapses. The study uses the classic Hodgkin-Huxley model to simulate the neuronal dynamics under the action of a train of Poissonian spikes.

arxiv-2401-14511.title: Automated Legal Reasoning with Discretion to Act using s(LAW)
arxiv-2401-14511.creator: Joaquín Arias Mar Moreno-Rebato Jose A. Rodriguez-García Sascha Ossowski
arxiv-2401-14511.description: Abstract † † footnotetext: This work has been supported by grant VAE: TED2021-131295B-C33 funded by MCIN/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033 and by the “European Union NextGenerationEU/PRTR”, by grant COSASS: PID2021-123673OB-C32 funded by MCIN/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033 and by “ERDF A way of making Europe”, and by grant 2023/00004/004 s(LAW) funded by URJC.

arxiv-2402-13104.title: Self-Perception Versus Objective Driving Behavior: Subject Study of Lateral Vehicle Guidance
arxiv-2402-13104.creator: Johann Haselberger Bernhard Schick Steffen Müller
arxiv-2402-13104.description: Abstract Advancements in technology are steering attention toward creating comfortable and acceptable driving characteristics in autonomous vehicles. Ensuring a safe and comfortable ride experience is vital for the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicles, as mismatches in driving styles between humans and autonomous systems can impact passenger confidence.

arxiv-2404-06702.title: What is Learnt by the LEArnable Front-end (LEAF)? Adapting Per-Channel Energy Normalisation (PCEN) to Noisy Conditions
arxiv-2404-06702.creator: Hanyu Meng, Vidhyasaharan Sethu, Eliathamby Ambikairajah
arxiv-2404-06702.description: Abstract There is increasing interest in the use of the LEArnable Front-end (LEAF) in a variety of speech processing systems. However, there is a dearth of analyses of what is actually learnt and the relative importance of training the different components of the front-end.

arxiv-2504-19909.title: Analytic reconstruction with massive particles: one-loop amplitudes for 0 → q ¯ ​ q ​ t ​ t ¯ ​ H 0\to\bar{q}qt\bar{t}H
arxiv-2504-19909.creator: John M. Campbell, Giuseppe De Laurentis, R. Keith Ellis
arxiv-2504-19909.description: Abstract We present an analytic reconstruction of one-loop amplitudes for the process 0 → q ¯ ​ q ​ t ​ t ¯ ​ H 0\to\bar{q}qt\bar{t}H . Our calculation is a novel use of analytic reconstruction, retaining explicit covariance in the massive spin states through the massive spinor-helicity formalism.

arxiv-2509-10204.title: A Categorical Approach to Finiteness Conditions
arxiv-2509-10204.creator: David Forsman
arxiv-2509-10204.description: Abstract We introduce a general categorical framework for finiteness conditions that unifies classical notions such as Noetherianness, Artinianness, and various forms of topological compactness. This is achieved through the concept of τ \tau -compactness , defined relative to a coverage τ \tau .

arxiv-2601-07104.title: A search for feebly-interacting particles in B B decays with missing energy at Belle
arxiv-2601-07104.creator: M. Abumusabh, I. Adachi, L. Aggarwal, H. Ahmed, Y. Ahn, H. Aihara, N. Akopov, S. Alghamdi, M. Alhakami, A. Aloisio, N. Althubiti, K. Amos, N. Anh Ky, C. Antonioli, D. M. catholic-encyclopedia-1913-charles-lebru.creator: George Williamson
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-charles-lebru.description: Article 'Charles Lebrun' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10569012.title: Cell Death Mechanism of Organometallic Ruthenium(II) and Iridium(III) Arene Complexes on HepG2 and Vero Cells
pmc-10569012.creator: Serdar
pmc-10569012.description: Due to side effects and toxicity associated with platinum-derived metal-based drugs, extensive research has been conducted on ruthenium (Ru) complexes. We aim to synthesize a highly oil soluble Ru(II)–p-cymene complex (Ru1) with an aliphatic chain group, a bimetallic Ru(II)–p-cymene complex (Ru2) with N,S,S triple-coordination and a bimetallic Ir(III)–pentamethylcyclopentadienyl complex (Ir1) with S,S double-coordination.

pmc-11459934.title: Comparative outcomes of cardioplegic arrest versus beating heart in pediatric undergoing extracardiac total cavopulmonary connection
pmc-11459934.creator: Wenting Wang, Peiyao Zhang, Yu Jin, Jia Liu, He Wang, Jinping Liu
pmc-11459934.description: BackgroundTotal cavopulmonary connection (TCPC) is a definitive palliative procedure for functionally univentricular congenital heart disease. The study aims to compare the impact of on-pump cardioplegic arrest and on-pump beating heart cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) on the prognosis of pediatric patients undergoing extracardiac TCPC.

pmc-11460152.title: The 2023 WHO updates on skin tumors: advances since the 2018 edition
pmc-11460152.creator: Francesco Fortarezza, Gerardo Cazzato, Giuseppe Ingravallo, Angelo Paolo Dei Tos
pmc-11460152.description: SummaryPathology is pivotal in diagnosing skin tumors, and the precision of diagnosis is crucial to devise customized treatment plans and enhance patient care in dermatology. The latest edition of the World Health Organization’s classification of skin tumors serves as a comprehensive compendium, summarizing and categorizing all recent advancements in both anatomical-pathological and molecular aspects of cutaneous neoplasms.

pmc-11675422.title: Adsorption of Cr(VI) Using Organoclay/Alginate Hydrogel Beads and Their Application to Tannery Effluent
pmc-11675422.creator: Mayra X. Muñoz-Martinez, Iván F. Macías-Quiroga, Nancy R. Sanabria-González
pmc-11675422.description: The tanning industry is among the most environmentally harmful activities globally due to the pollution of lakes and rivers from its effluents. Hexavalent chromium, a metal in tannery effluents, has adverse effects on human health and ecosystems, requiring the development of removal techniques.

pmc-11888644.title: Comparative Analysis of Alkaline Phosphatase Levels in Gingival Crevicular Fluid: A Three-Time Point Study Comparing Clear Aligners and Fixed Orthodontic Appliances
pmc-11888644.creator: Manish Pisarla, Ravi Rathod, Rajivi Kalpakuri, P Anoop Kumar, B Nishanth, Akshay Goje, Tejaswi Kala
pmc-11888644.description: Aim:To evaluate the alkaline phosphatase level in gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) at three time points using clear aligners and fixed orthodontic appliances.Materials and Methods:A prospective randomized controlled trial was conducted in a tertiary care hospital to treat patients with 4–6 mm crowding in their upper front teeth. The study involved 20 patients, with 10 assigned to each group.

pmc-12392490.title: I know i’m not meant to ‘diet’ but is it ok to lose a few pounds while pregnant?: a qualitative analysis of Mumsnet discussion forum posts to understand women’s experiences of and views on weight and weight management while living with excess weight during and after pregnancy
pmc-12392490.creator: Mackenzie Fong, Erin Kelly, Sarah Gregory, Catherine V Talbot, Maria Raisa Jessica Aquino
pmc-12392490.description: BackgroundMany women start pregnancy with obesity. It is also common for women to gain excess weight during pregnancy, and many find it challenging to lose this weight after birth. Pregnant and postnatal women may seek weight management support through online discussion forums.

pmc-12618648.title: Integrating machine learning and experimental validation identifies a post-translational modification gene signature for prognosis and treatment response in breast cancer
pmc-12618648.creator: Lina Zhao, Lijuan Song, Hongzhi Wang, Wen Tian, Junfeng Xi, Bo Zhang, Yue Cai, Lei Hou
pmc-12618648.description: Breast cancer (BC) is the most prevalent malignancy among women, and the steadily increasing disease burden has garnered considerable global attention. Post-translational modifications (PTMs) are critical in the initiation and progression of BC. This study aimed to elucidate the associations between diverse PTMs and the prognosis of patients with BC.

pmc-12849675.title: Prognostic value of different immunohistopathological patterns and Ki67 proliferation index for Merkel cell carcinoma
pmc-12849675.creator: Katharina Theresa Obermeier, Wenko Smolka, Maximilian Kollmuss, Sabina Noreen Wuersching, Ina Dewenter, Philipp Poxleiter, Sven Otto, Yoana Malenova, Florian Fegg, Paris Liokatis
pmc-12849675.description: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare and aggressive neuroendocrine skin tumor, which preferentially appears in the head and neck area. Overall 5-year survival is about 66–70% in patients with non-metastasized tumors and reduces to 42% in cases with regional metastases, and down to 18% in case of distant metastases.

pmc-13170714.title: HALP outperforms systemic inflammatory biomarkers for prognosis in locally advanced cervical cancer treated with concurrent chemoradiotherapy
pmc-13170714.creator: Xiaojun Zhang, Yilin Yin, Tiantian Yang, Yawen Cong, Shengjun Ji, Yutian Zhao, Yan Kong
pmc-13170714.description: Patients with locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC) treated with concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) show substantial heterogeneity in survival outcomes, whereas the comparative prognostic value of systemic inflammatory and nutritional biomarkers remains unclear. This study aimed to compare pretreatment inflammatory biomarkers, identify the most informative prognostic indicator, and develop a practical risk-stratification model for LACC.

pmc-13220365.title: Thalidomide memorial activity: pedagogies of creativity, joy and immersion in medical education
pmc-13220365.creator: Anuradha Joshi, Dhruv Prajapati, Kuldeepsinh Parmar
pmc-13220365.description: BackgroundAlthough medical education has advanced rapidly over the past few decades, literature reveals lack of interest and curiosity of students in medical classrooms. Considering this, one of the major prerequisites in medical education is to, encourage the use of creative and novel pedagogies in medical curriculum.

pmc-13253020.title: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews of School-Based Nutrition Interventions to Determine Outcomes Used and Their Measurement Tools
pmc-13253020.creator: Dilara Olgacher, Sarah Aldukair, Mike Clarke, Danielle McCarthy, Jayne V Woodside
pmc-13253020.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ContextSchool-based nutrition interventions have the potential to promote dietary behaviors and other outcomes among children and adolescents. However, inconsistent reporting of outcomes and measurement tools limits evidence synthesis and the identification of effective intervention strategies.ObjectiveThis umbrella review aimed to synthesize the range of outcomes related to diet, health, well-being, and education reported in systematic reviews of school-based nutrition interventions, along with the measurement tools used.

pmc-13265458.title: The impact of school life and holidays on sleep and physical activity patterns in junior high school students: a small-sample longitudinal study using wearable devices
pmc-13265458.creator: Yun Chen, Kai Xu, Yifan Zhao, Zhongke Gu, Shanshan Zhang, Gangrui Chen, Jiansong Dai
pmc-13265458.description: BackgroundThe structured day hypothesis posits that the characteristics of a structured school environment play a protective role in adolescents’ physical activity. Existing studies predominantly rely on subjective reports or short-term monitoring, lacking longitudinal objective evidence that covers a full academic year cycle for Chinese students who are under high academic pressure.

pmc-13295853.title: Access to care for adults living with spinal muscular atrophy in the UK
pmc-13295853.creator: Robert Muni-Lofra, Holly Borland, Katie Nevin, Anna Rutherford, Alex Dungavel, Jassi Michell-Sodhi, Sherryl Chatfield, Katie Pape, Andy Rose, Paula Fenty, Gemma Martin, Sunitha Narayan, Emilia Bartram, Nicholas Emery, Marina Di Marco, Emma Manchester, Nicola White, Heledd Tomos, Elizabeth Davies, Francesca Morris, Aleks Carver, Elena Karkkainen, Jess Page, Fiona Norwood, Hayley Davis, Richard Jon Walters, Charlotte F Dougan, Priya Devi Shanmugarajah, Maria Elena Farrugia, Tracey A Willis, Stefen Brady, Annamaria Kiss-Csenki, Andria Merrison, Saam Sedehizadeh, Charlotte Brierley, Nick P Davies, Clare M Galtrey, Matt Parton, James B Lilleker, Channa Hewamadduma

pmc-13433370.creator: Kaylin Lewandowski, Skylar R Hopkins, Michael Reiskind, Bethany McGregor
pmc-13433370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The filarial nematode, Dirofilaria immitis (Leidy) (Spirurida: Onchocercidae), is an obligate mosquito-borne pathogen transmitted by at least 26 species of mosquitoes in the United States. Due to its size and migration through mosquito tissues during its first 3 larval stages (L1-L3), it can damage the mosquito to the point of death, thereby hindering transmission to its vertebrate host (eg canids and other carnivores). Mosquito species vary in competency for D.

pmc-13506625.title: Craniofacial morphology and its association with masseter and medial pterygoid muscle thickness among adults from a population-based sample
pmc-13506625.creator: Annalena Spilz, Christian Schwahn, Karl-Friedrich Krey, Robin Bülow, Henry Völzke, Markus Krüger, Amro Daboul
pmc-13506625.description: ObjectivesThe association between craniofacial morphology and the cross-sectional areas (CSA) of the masseter and medial pterygoid muscles using Procrustes-based geometric morphometrics on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data was investigated.Materials and methodsThis cross-sectional study included 692 participants from the first examination wave of the second cohort of the population-based Study of Health in Pomerania (SHIP-TREND-0).

pmc-13564337.title: Mortality Records Guide UAV-Based Assessment of Power-Line Conspicuity at a Black-Necked Crane Breeding Site
pmc-13564337.creator: Xintong Li, Zhengwu Pan, Yumin Guo
pmc-13564337.description: Simple SummaryPower lines and livestock fences can injure or kill large birds, but managers often do not know which structures should be examined first. We monitored 40 Black-necked Cranes at a breeding site in Qinghai, China, from 2020 to 2025 and combined tracking records with field searches and standardized drone photographs.

pmc-13672281.title: Docosahexaenoic acid remodels lipid composition of lipid rafts and mitochondrial function in ApoE4/4 mouse brain: a multi-omic investigation
pmc-13672281.creator: Yu Liu, Jingjing Xu, Xixiang Wang, Lu Liu, Xiuwen Ren, Yunyun Gong, Chen Miao, Mengyang Sun, Shaobo Zhou, Xinjing Guo, Linhong Yuan
pmc-13672281.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is an irreversible neurodegenerative disorder lacking curative therapies, with ApoE4 as the strongest genetic risk factor driving lipid dyshomeostasis and neuronal damage in the central nervous system. Lipid rafts, cholesterol- and sphingolipid-rich membrane microdomains, govern key neuronal signalling, and dysfunction of these microdomains mediates the progression of preclinical pathological lesions in ApoE4 carriers.

uslaw-usc-t7-s7107.title: 7 U.S.C. § 7107 — Enforcement
uslaw-usc-t7-s7107.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s7107.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 99 (Sheep Promotion, Research, And Information). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Jurisdiction Each district court of the United States shall have jurisdiction specifically to enforce, and to prevent and restrain a person from violating, an order or regulation issued under this chapter. (b) Referral to Attorney General A civil action authorized to be brought.
